reads.fallback: from_lattice for new settings; old saved settings retain fixed size
local for new configurations; historical recorded settings remain unchanged

monalisaSpotFwhmNm.description: Default Gaussian MoNaLISA spot FWHM for this detector/path, in nm. Recorded with new acquisitions so offline reconstruction keeps the value that was configured at acquisition time.

monalisaScanOrientation.description: Detector-specific default scan-to-camera orientation for Gaussian MoNaLISA. Use Auto/Manual in reconstruction to override; new recordings snapshot this value.

monalisaLocalFootprintMode.description: Default Local fit sizing: resolve from localization or use an explicit fixed size.

monalisaLocalFootprintSizePx.description: Odd local footprint size in camera pixels, used only for Fixed sizing.

monalisaFitEstimator.description: Default Gaussian extraction method used with the shared fit footprint.

monalisaFitFootprintShape.description: Shape of the shared Gaussian fitting footprint.

monalisaFitFootprintMode.description: Sizing rule; ignored for lattice unit-cell ownership.

monalisaFitFootprintSizePx.description: Fixed square side or circular diameter in camera pixels.

monalisaFitFootprintSigmaFactor.description: Radius relative to spot sigma in FWHM-relative sizing.
